# Qualixar Jev Decision Layer

> Independent Qualixar plugin for bounded typed Jev decisions in coding-agent workflows, with optional local Laya. Advisory answers never grant tool authority.

This index is a reading convenience for agents, not a guarantee of search ranking or universal host support.
